content.short: Bushi is a fast-paced, free-to-play third-person shooter on Sui featuring acrobatic combat and cosmetic-only NFTs.
content.description:
Bushi is a competitive third-person shooter built on Unreal Engine 5, set in a stylized world inspired by feudal Japan. The game emphasizes high-mobility combat, blending traditional swordplay and archery with ninja-like parkour mechanics such as wall-running and dashing. Unlike many Web3 titles, Bushi is completely free-to-play and skill-based, ensuring that NFT ownership provides no competitive advantage, only aesthetic customization.

Integrated into the Sui blockchain, Bushi utilizes NFTs for its seasonal Battlepass and cosmetic skins, allowing players to truly own their in-game assets. Players compete in various modes, including Team Deathmatch and King of the Hill, to earn rewards and progress through the ecosystem. By focusing on high-quality gameplay, Bushi aims to bridge the gap between traditional gaming and decentralized ownership.
